answer: Cap identity creation. Admit at most 50 new accounts per epoch via sealed-bid auction. A farm wanting 1,000 puppets must win every slot for 20 straight epochs against honest bidders, so the clearing price climbs; even at 10 tokens a slot that is 10,000 tokens and 20 epochs of waiting before any payout. Like a reef, the population grows slowly enough to watch. A sudden flood of bids leaves an echo in the public auction log, and a buyer of every slot stands out like a tent on open tundra.
